office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes and advises county government on legal matters; four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney James Kennedy, in office since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Jefferson County Prosecuting Attorney since 2019 and Army veteran of two Iraq tours; the only candidate.
highlights: Prosecutor since 2019; helped create the county's first Children's Advocacy Center [S1]
Backs rehabilitative services and a restorative-justice pilot in therapeutic courts [S1]
Nearly six years in the U.S. Army [S1]
